API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApplication Segment ManagementGet all configured BA/ Inspect/ PRA Application Segments.
Get all configured BA/ Inspect/ PRA Application Segments.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/application/getAppsByType

Get all configured BA/ Inspect/ PRA Application Segments.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
expandAll
boolean

Additional information related to the applications

Default value: false
applicationType
string
REQUIRED

The type of application

Example: INSPECT
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

Example (auto)
